# Agent Orchestration

## Procedure
Assign independent parallel research; separate creation from QA; require sourced handoffs; log decisions; hold publication until human approval.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
